name: Flow POS – Point of Sale for WooCommerce
author: racmanuel.dev

sections.description:
Flow POS is a modern Point of Sale (POS) system for WooCommerce that transforms your WordPress store into a powerful in-store sales solution.

Sell in physical locations using your existing WooCommerce products, customers and inventory — all fully synchronized in real time.

Built with performance and flexibility in mind, Flow POS is designed for both business owners and developers, offering a clean POS experience and a powerful architecture with hooks and extensibility.

👉 Try it on your own store or integrate it into your workflow in minutes.

Why Flow POS?

Unlike traditional POS plugins, Flow POS focuses on:

  • ⚡ Speed and smooth checkout experience
  • 🔄 Real-time WooCommerce synchronization
  • 🧩 Modular architecture for scalability
  • 🧑‍💻 Developer-friendly (hooks & filters)
  • 🏪 Multi-store and multi-register ready

Whether you’re running a retail store or building solutions for clients, Flow POS adapts to your needs.

Core Features (Free)

  • 🛒 Full POS checkout with WooCommerce order creation
  • 💳 Multiple and split payments in a single sale
  • 🧾 Cash register sessions (open / close tracking)
  • 👤 Customer search and on-the-fly creation
  • ⏸️ Suspended carts for paused transactions
  • 📦 Real-time stock validation
  • 📊 Sales summary after each transaction
  • 📈 POS dashboard with operational KPIs
  • 🎨 Customizable register interface (colors & UI)
  • 🔌 Developer-ready architecture with hooks and filters

Pro Features

Flow POS Pro unlocks advanced tools for growing businesses:

  • 📊 Advanced reports and sales analytics
  • 👥 Staff roles and permissions
  • 💰 Cash management and audit logs
  • 🔁 Returns and refunds management
  • 🧠 Customer insights and purchase history
  • 📦 Advanced order management

Built for Developers

Flow POS is not just a POS system — it’s a platform.

  • Clean and modular architecture
  • Extensible via hooks and filters
  • Compatible with WooCommerce workflows
  • Designed for customization and integrations

Perfect for agencies, SaaS builders and advanced WooCommerce projects.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or higher
  • WooCommerce installed and activated
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to Flow POS in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does Flow POS require WooCommerce?

Yes. Flow POS extends WooCommerce and uses it to manage products, customers and orders.

Can multiple cashiers use the POS at the same time?

Yes. Flow POS supports multiple registers and concurrent POS sessions.

Are POS sales stored as WooCommerce orders?

Yes. Every transaction is automatically created as a WooCommerce order.

Is Flow POS free?

Yes. The core plugin is 100% free. A Pro version is available with advanced features.
